--- Page 1 ---
Date: June 9, 1970

PHILIP MORRIS
U.S.A.
INTER-OFFICE CORRESPONDENCE
RICHMOND, VIRGINIA

To: P.M. Sales Personnel

From: . R. A. Tamol

Subject: . TempiLabel Use Instructions

1. You will receive 3 cartons of experimental cigarettes in Lido cartons in insulated containers via air mail. Please save the containers for return shipment to PM R&D.

2. One cigarette pack in each carton with a red taped top has a TempiLabel on the side against the carton wall. The label "Bullseye" will turn black if any of the four temperatures are reached (110°F, 120°F, 130°F, 140°F).

3. Inspect the pack temperature labels once a day to see what maximum temperature was reached.

4. After the test period please return the cigarettes in the insulated containers with maximum TempiLabel data. to:

Philip Morris Inc.
Research Center
P.O. Box 3D
Richmond, Virginia 23206

c/o R. A. Tamol
